_comment: Branding overrides merged into openvscode-server's product.json by install-editor.sh.
Code-OSS is MIT, which permits rebranding; rebranding is also how we stop shipping Microsoft's
trademarks, which we are NOT licensed to use. Only display strings and links are overridden.
extensionsGallery      - must stay Open VSX. Pointing a non-Microsoft product at the VS Code
Marketplace violates its terms of use.
dataFolderName /       - these decide where the server writes its data. Renaming them moves
serverDataFolderName     ~/.openvscode-server, which is exactly where install-editor.sh seeds
the machine settings, so they must move together or not at all.
applicationName        - the CLI binary and its bundled helper scripts resolve by this name.
Keys starting with _ are stripped before merging. A key set to null is DELETED from product.json
rather than set to null — see defaultChatAgent below.
_comment.defaultChatAgent: GitHub Copilot. This key names the chat agent the workbench sets itself up for — Copilot setup
prompts, GitHub sign-in, and a built-in setup agent that intercepts Chat requests.
KNOW ITS LIMIT: deleting it here reaches only SERVER-side readers. The browser workbench gets
its product config INLINED AT BUILD TIME (gulpfile.reh.ts -> product.ts substitution), so this
deletion cannot remove the Copilot chat gating from a stock tarball — that removal lives in
our fork's patches (github.com/oyren-ai/openvscode-server, branch oyren/1.109). This entry is
kept as belt-and-braces for server-side consumers and for any future build that reads the
trustedExtensionAuthAccess: pre-authorises Copilot's extensions to take GitHub auth sessions
